prompt.en: Write the Book IV line. What is the seed built of, is any vital force needed, and is there a difference from the boiled seed?

text.en: The seed is built of four families of carbon molecules with exact shapes: fats, sugars, proteins and nucleotide chains. Every one can be made in a flask, so no vital force is needed for the molecules. The live seed's proteins are folded into their working shapes; the boiled seed's are unfolded and tangled. Everything else is the same, including the DNA.
